note: Tricky real one: after a signed offer, HR points to the portal for bank and ID details. Caution, not critical.
text:
Hi Morgan,

Welcome to Calloway Partners! Now that you've signed your offer letter, please complete your new-hire paperwork in Workday before your start date. You'll be asked to enter your bank account details for direct deposit and upload your passport or driver's license for I-9 verification. Please don't email these documents; enter them only in Workday.

Best,
People Operations, Calloway Partners
onboarding@callowaypartners.com
